html:
Nicolás Maduro was the president of Venezuela from 2013 until January 2026, when United States forces captured him in Caracas and took him to New York to face drug trafficking charges.

A former bus driver and union leader, he rose under Hugo Chávez to be foreign minister and vice-president, and narrowly won the election after Chávez's death in 2013. His years saw the hyperinflation, the collapse of oil output and the flight of millions in the refugee crisis. He ruled by decree, jailed opponents and crushed protests, and many countries rejected his re-elections of 2018 and 2024.

On 3 January 2026 American forces struck targets in northern Venezuela and seized him and his wife. He pleaded not guilty in New York.
sum: Nicolás Maduro was the president of Venezuela from 2013 until January 2026, when United States forces captured him in Caracas and took him to New York to face drug trafficking charges.
